guards.exact_registration: retirement_target and retire require one registered child entry and validate its derived key/path
guards.age: wrapper and Store.retire both require path age greater than 3600 seconds
guards.KEEP: Store route refuses KEEP marker before deletion
guards.lease: Store.retire takes the existing nonblocking exclusive entry lock
guards.references: existing wrapper scans suites.conf, env files, pending requests and worker metadata for name/path
guards.process: existing wrapper scans process argv, cwd, executable and open files
guards.fingerprint_race: existing wrapper fingerprints candidate before Store.retire; Store revalidates entry inode/ownership
guards.journal: retirement uses existing pending.json format, _roll, _validate_transition and recover
guards.index_registration: retirement removes only the exact registration and entry and appends the name to retired
guards.receipts: retirement projection omits only the target report deletion; unrelated and target provision receipts remain
guards.owned_delete: existing _delete_owned is the sole Store-route payload deletion implementation
guards.legacy: Store route is considered only when the legacy workroot target and associated leftovers are absent
